reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 22.1 caps audits at once per twelve months, requires thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours without unreasonable disruption, and off-site conduct where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.

§ 22.2 allocates audit costs to Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent and expressly bars direct access to Customer systems and unrelated Customer Data — matching the preferred position's cost and no-system-access parameters.
No redline or comment is expected or present for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs, and the deterministic frequency check passes.
Rationale's scope claim is consistent with the supplied paragraphs (Section 22 is the audit provision); § 22.3 adds further customer-favourable protections, so no negotiation issue should be raised.
